speech.heard: 113 of 208 mapped countries and territories sit below the 2.1 replacement benchmark. Yellow marks 2.1 or more and dark blue marks below 2.1 with 113 below that benchmark. South Korea sits at 0.7 births per woman. Nigeria sits at 4.4 births per woman. India sits at 2 births per woman. Total fertility rate represents the number of children that would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year. So where does your country rank on the map?
